purpose: Runtime module closure required by the candidate (v0.2.1) rich path. The bundled tokenizer helper (strata_tokenizer_helper.py) imports the donor strata_tokenizer.py, which imports the sibling gguf_reader.py (stdlib only) and the `regex` module; chat-template rendering requires `jinja2`. These are the ONLY third-party runtime modules of the text path. Versions are pinned here with real PyPI sdist digests; the installed closure is verified against this lock in build-package.py and must not silently fall back to unverified versions.
verificationMethod: PyPI JSON index (pypi.org/pypi/<project>/<version>/json) sdist sha256; recorded 2026-10-20. Actual module availability is probed at runtime (missing module => precise dependency cause, fail-closed).

regex.role: donor tokenizer pre-tokenizer/BPE (`regex.compile(QWEN35_PATTERN)`), imported by strata_tokenizer.py
regex.note: Wheels are platform-specific; the sdist sha256 is the canonical pin. The pre-tokenizer pattern uses `\p{L}`/`\p{M}` and requires a real `regex` module, not the stdlib `re`.

jinja2.role: chat-template renderer (donor frontend ChatTemplate) - ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment(trim_blocks, lstrip_blocks, loopcontrols) + tojson + raise_exception

strata_tokenizer.py.role: donor tokenizer of record (reads GGUF tokenizer metadata / extracted pack tokenizer/ dir)

gguf_reader.py.role: minimal GGUF v3 header reader (stdlib only; no ggml/gguf-py dependency)

class: The actual `regex` module and the donor module are separate facts: a missing donor `strata_tokenizer.py` is NOT proof that `regex` itself is absent, and vice versa. The helper reports each precisely and fails ONLY the affected text request.
